== Description ==

Custom "WORLDS 2025" collector's edition ''Coruscant: Galactic Senate'' card shared by [[Thomas Santosuosso]] ahead of the [[2025 World Championship]] on 2 October 2025, featuring a composite group portrait of players inside the Galactic Senate chamber.

== Source and credit ==

* '''Source:''' Star Wars CCG Slack, #2025-worlds-collectors-edition-cards, Thomas Santosuosso (LargePorg), 2 October 2025 (15:37 EDT): "DS Galactic Senate". Original file name: worlds_coruscant_galactic_senate.png (2073×1497, 5.9 MB); Slack file id F09JFN537MG. Scaled here to 1123×811 to fit the wiki's 2 MB upload limit.
* '''Shared by:''' [[Thomas Santosuosso]] (Slack: LargePorg)
* '''Date:''' 2 October 2025 (Slack post date).
* '''Identification:''' Custom composite card image (not an event photograph); depicts [[Hayes Hunter]] in the left foreground and other players.
